regime_context: The detector shows a Canada/TSX regime dominated by Oil & Gas Producers (rank 1, score 1.91, durable breadth 0.929, eligible, but crowded) in a one-narrative structure with only 6 of 16 themes eligible and absorption at 0.31. The only validated edge is drawdown/shake-out control via the absolute-trend gate; momentum rank is a focus lens only (rank-IC ~0), and direction accuracy on this track record is 0.324, so I am leaning low and prioritizing trend-gate-eligible, non-crowded subjects.
emerging_watch: Gold Miners (rank 2, score 1.015) is the highest-ranked non-eligible theme and the named rotation challenger to Oil & Gas, but its durability_bar is only 0.16 and breadth 0.067 — leadership is not confirmed. Watching for Gold Miners to become trend-gate eligible (a break above its own absolute-trend threshold) while Oil & Gas breadth falls below ~0.6; until that combination appears, the energy-dominant one-narrative stands.

theses.subject: Oil & Gas Producers
theses.thesis: Oil & Gas is the only theme with a strong combination of top rank (1), high durability_bar (0.71), wide breadth (0.929), and absolute-trend eligibility (trend-gate leg). It is the dominant one-narrative. The trend gate is the one validated risk-control leg, and this theme passes it; crowding (z 1.19, flagged crowded) is a caution that argues for restraint, not avoidance. Rotation shows it as leader with margin 0.895 over the challenger, supported by breadth-of-rotation narrowing (0.38 eligible). This is a directional lean to remain exposed, expressed as surviving the trend-gate test rather than any predicted outperformance.
theses.dissent: Crowding at z 1.19 with one_narrative=true and absorption low (0.31) means the leadership is narrow and potentially fragile; the hurst_tag is 'mixed' (not cleanly trending), and a crowded leader can unwind rapidly in an unscheduled news shock (macro unscheduled_share is 0.75). Momentum rank itself has no forward edge.

theses.subject: Big Banks
theses.thesis: Big Banks is the second-cleanest exposure in this state: eligible=true, durability_bar 0.63 (second-highest after the leader), hurst_tag 'trend' (cleanest trend label among eligible non-crowded themes), and not crowded (z 0.15). Unlike Oil & Gas, it is not crowded, so the one validated drawdown/trend-gate leg can apply without the reflexive crowding caution. It is a diversification-lean built on the trend gate, not on momentum rank (score 0.635 is modest).
evidence: absolute-trend gate validated as risk control
theses.dissent: Score is only 0.635 at rank 5, and breadth (0.429) is mediocre — trend is intact but not broad. Financials are highly correlated with the TSX itself, so this may be beta, not theme alpha; in a one-narrative energy market, banks may simply lag the leader.

falsifier.text: ZEB.TO closes below its 50-day moving average for 5 consecutive trading days before the check-by date

theses.subject: Technology
theses.thesis: Technology is eligible (trend gate passes) but crowded at z 1.36 (the highest crowding_z in the set) while its score is actually negative (-0.037) and durability_bar is only 0.71 with a 'mixed' hurst_tag. Crowding is never a fade or short trigger, but combined with negative relative momentum and a mixed trend profile, this theme fails the modest bar for a constructive lean. The avoidance is a statement that we do not want new exposure here, not a sell call.
theses.dissent: Hurst_tag 'mixed' and eligible=true means the absolute trend is still technically intact; breadth 0.8 is high, suggesting broad participation. If the macro narrative is ai_tech-dominant (macro_narrative lists ai_tech second), Technology could re-assert as a narrative leader despite current negative momentum.

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
